acceptance: The pack deadline constant is named for the pack (for example repoContractPackDeadline), since it bounds every stage, the commit gate included.
docs/architecture/packages/internal-commitgate.md names the deadline constant instead of the number 120 s.
fix: Rename repoContractFloorDeadline and floorFailureDiagnostic to pack names, and replace the number in the package note with the constant name.
source: architecture review of the ship-backstop rebuild (PR #1691 r2), 2026-11-23
summary: The architecture seat on the ship-backstop rebuild found two MEDIUM issues that do not block after round 2: repoContractFloorDeadline is now the deadline of every repo-contract stage, so a maintainer tuning the build floor changes the commit gate unknowingly; and internal-commitgate.md:93 repeats the value 120 s, which goes stale if the constant changes.
title: The repo-contract pack deadline has a pack name and one home
